notes.title: Parking Garage Simulator – Developer Diary #2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!
We’re back with our second developer diary for Parking Garage Simulator. Since the first update, we’ve focused on making the garage feel more alive, unpredictable, and full of stories. Today, we’d like to show you what’s changed, how the world has evolved, and what’s coming next.
🎭 New Events and Encounters
After months of work, the garage is no longer just about parking cars. Unexpected events now occur during your shifts:

Mafia Scene. A group shows up, fires shots in the air, and threatens you.

Government Inspection. An officer checks your license. No paperwork means an instant fine.

Homeless NPC. A character looking for work, adding a social and moral dimension to your decisions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702541/34ce7b9ccd300427fc0263e118d0e6b1a02e0e87.png"]
🌆 Bringing the Lot to Life
We’ve been working hard to make NPCs feel like real people:

NPC Dialogues. Characters now talk, comment, and react to you.

Pedestrian Behaviour. They wander into the road, crack jokes, or simply watch you work.

New Missions. Small tasks added throughout the day to increase your responsibilities.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702541/fe4a9deb9eb99b1faa0ffed2dcf56ff7d3852d17.png"]
⚙️ Systems and Improvements
We’ve also reworked and polished a lot under the hood:

Loan Shark System. Completely rebuilt, now more stable and balanced.

Vehicle Traffic. Turning issues fixed, cars move more smoothly.

Headlight System. Automatic headlights at night for realism and visibility.

New Sounds and Effects. Added audio for mafia threats, inspections, and NPC dialogues.

Bug Fixes and Optimisation. Numerous issues resolved for smoother performance.
🎮 Demo Coming Soon
The public demo is just a few days away. Don’t forget to join our community for early previews, behind-the-scenes content, and to help shape future features.
👉 Join Our Discord!
Thanks for following our journey! We can’t wait to share what’s coming next.

notes.title: Parking Garage Simulator – Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’re excited to share the very first official Devlog for Parking Garage Simulator with you.

The game has come a long way since its early prototype days, and today we’d like to show you what has changed, how far we’ve come, and what’s coming next.
🏗️ Old Garage VS New Garage
At the very beginning, the parking lot was nothing more than a few cars and a simple AI.

After months of development, it now looks completely different:

More detailed parking areas and new layouts

Variety of vehicles including SUVs, sedans, and luxury cars

HDRP lighting & full day–night cycle

More dynamic NPC behavior
🎨 From Concept to Reality
Not only the final result matters to us, but also the journey. Here’s how some features evolved:

Barcode Machine → Started as a simple idea, now it’s an interactive device where you issue tickets to customers.

Valet Worker → From sketches to a fully animated NPC who parks cars for you.

Office Area → From a plain block to a detailed and decorative workspace.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702541/ae0a66b83300f95fe3b1ce776ace00e65a38dad0.gif"]
😂 Funny Moments During Development
Game development also brought us plenty of laughs. Here are some of the funniest bugs and moments:

Some customers tried to take their cars without paying.

One customer dropped off their car fully dressed, but returned naked! (clothing system bug 🤣)

A drunk customer jumped into the car without even taking their change.

The thief NPC was so clumsy it looked like they wanted to get caught.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702541/a7ae74c4f4dd4425a28b548d9c3f0adf1213d50e.gif"]
✨ New Features
The latest version of the game now includes:

Barcode Machine System → Issue the correct ticket and hand it to the customer.

License & City Inspector → Run your business illegally and you might get raided.

Mafia & Loan Shark → Dangerous but exciting side systems.

Valet System → Hire workers to reduce your load (but don’t forget their salaries!).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702541/eb4c5e92c1431eb7abfc68a9b2023cadbb27305b.gif"]
🔮 Upcoming Features
We are currently working on several big systems that haven’t been added yet:

Car Wash 🚿 – Clean the dirty vehicles.

Car Repairs 🔧 – Fix minor breakdowns.

Car Sales Area 🚘 – Display and negotiate for second-hand cars.

Office Decoration & Customization 🛠️ – Add a coffee machine or neon lights to your desk.

Surprise Mini Games 🎮 – Fun side activities.
📊 What’s Next?
We really value your feedback! Which feature would you like us to prioritize? 

🔧 Car Repairs

🚿 Car Wash

🎮 Mini Games

🛠️ Office Decoration & Customization

👉 The most voted feature will be highlighted in the next devlog!
🔜 Coming Soon to Early Access
Parking Garage Simulator will soon be available on Steam Early Access.

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist so you don’t miss the release!
